content.value_statement: Ad campaigns waste spend when landing pages miss the promise made in the ad. This skill checks message match, offer visibility, speed evidence, forms, and mobile issues before launch.
actual_capabilities: Compares ad headlines and hooks with landing page copy.
Checks the first viewport for the promised offer and primary CTA.
Labels speed and mobile evidence as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Counts required form fields and names specific friction points.
Produces Pass, Partial, or Fix statuses with owner handoffs.
limitations: It does not rewrite copy, redesign layouts, or build forms.
It does not compute ROAS Quality Score or make launch approval decisions.
It needs destination page content and ad copy to check continuity.
Speed and mobile checks are estimates unless measured data or connector output is available.

use_cases.title: Pre-Launch Page Check
use_cases.description: Review a campaign landing page before launch and identify gaps that could waste paid traffic.

use_cases.title: Quality Score Diagnosis
use_cases.description: Investigate why an ad may receive a below-average landing-page-experience rating.

use_cases.title: Agency Handoff Review
use_cases.description: Create a concise punch list for page, offer, and account owners before final launch approval.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Landing Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner preflight with one URL and one ad.
prompt_templates.prompt: Preflight this landing page before launch: [URL]. The ad headline is: [headline]. Check message match, offer visibility, speed evidence, form friction, and mobile rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Ads
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review across several ad variants.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this landing page against these ad headlines and hooks: [paste ads]. Mark each check Pass, Partial, or Fix, and name the exact gap for every Fix.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Landing Experience Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting for likely Quality Score issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: This campaign may receive a below-average landing-page-experience rating. Review [URL] against [ad copy] and explain which lever is failing: message match, first viewport, speed, form friction, or mobile.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Launch Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff for page and account owners.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a launch handoff for [URL] and [ad copy]. Include the five-check punch list, measured versus estimated evidence labels, repair owner, assumptions, and next best skill.

output_examples.input: A search ad promises a 20 percent discount, but the landing page hero only says Request a demo.
output: Message match: Fix. The discount promised in the ad is not visible on the page.
Above the fold: Partial. A CTA appears, but the offer is missing from the first viewport.
Next owner: offer wording and page copy should go to the landing page owner before launch.

output_examples.input: A mobile landing page has a visible offer and CTA, but the form asks for ten required fields.
output: Mobile render: Pass. The offer, CTA, and form are readable on a narrow viewport.
Form friction: Fix. Ten required fields create avoidable conversion friction.
Evidence label: user-provided page review; speed remains estimated until measured data is supplied.

output_examples.input: The user provides PageSpeed data, ad copy, and a landing page for a direct-response campaign.
output: Speed check: Measured. Use the supplied Core Web Vitals data and report any launch risk.
Continuity check: Compare every ad promise with the page headline, value prop, offer, and CTA.
Handoff: Route page fixes to landing-optimizer and scoring decisions to ad-account-auditor.

best_practices: Provide the destination URL, ad headlines, promised offer, and campaign goal in one request.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated before making launch recommendations.
Route each failed check to one repair owner so the next action is clear.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to redesign the full landing page or write final page copy.
Do not treat estimated speed or mobile checks as measured performance data.
Do not use it as the final account audit or launch approval gate.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks message match, first-viewport offer and CTA visibility, speed evidence, form friction, and mobile rendering.

faq.question: Can it rewrite my landing page?
faq.answer: No. It identifies gaps and routes page repair work to the correct owner or sibling skill.

faq.question: Does it require a crawler or API?
faq.answer: No. It can work from pasted page copy and user-provided speed data. Connectors are optional.

faq.question: How does it help Quality Score?
faq.answer: It finds landing-page relevance and experience issues before they hurt campaign performance.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the destination URL or page copy, ad headlines, the promised offer, and the campaign goal.

faq.question: Can it make the final launch decision?
faq.answer: No. It prepares a preflight report. Final scoring and launch gates belong to an account auditor.
